record.paper_title: On free curves and related open problems
record.context_brief: Best lower bound for Tjurina number of line arrangements
record.original_question: What is the optimal lower bound for the global Tjurina number τ(C) of a line arrangement C in P^2?

evidence.quote: However, it is an open question to find the best lower bound for the global Tjurina number of line arrangements.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C \subset \mathbb{P}^2_{\mathbb{C}}$ be a line arrangement, i.e. a reduced plane curve which is a union of $d$ distinct lines defined by a homogeneous polynomial $f \in \mathbb{C}[x,y,z]_d$. For each singular point $p$ of $C$ (a multiple point of the arrangement), let $\tau(C,p) = \dim_{\mathbb{C}} \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^2,p} / (f, \partial_x f, \partial_y f, \partial_z f)_p$ denote the local Tjurina number, and define the global Tjurina number
$$\tau(C) = \sum_{p \in \mathrm{Sing}(C)} \tau(C,p).$$
Determine the optimal (i.e. sharp) lower bound for $\tau(C)$, expressed as a function of the degree $d$ (and possibly other discrete invariants of the arrangement such as the maximal multiplicity of a singular point), and characterize the line arrangements attaining this bound.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of finding the best (sharp) lower bound for the global Tjurina number of line arrangements in $\mathbb{P}^2$ has received much attention, with successive improvements over the classical du Plessis–Wall bound by Dimca–Sticlaru, Beorchia–Miró-Roig, and others. Several improved lower bounds have been proved (notably the minimal-value results of Dimca–Sernesi and the 2018 paper of Dimca on minimal Tjurina line arrangements), but no universally sharp bound covering all line arrangements has been established; recent works (2024–2025) continue to refine these inequalities, indicating the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: On the minimal value of global Tjurina numbers for line arrangements
status_evidence.snippet: We study lower bounds for global Tjurina numbers of line arrangements in the projective plane.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on lower bounds for global Tjurina numbers of line arrangements, with improvements but no settled sharp bound.

status_evidence.title: Some remarks on plane curves related to freeness
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work continues to refine bounds on Tjurina numbers of plane curves and line arrangements.
status_evidence.claim: Continuing recent research suggests the optimal lower bound problem is not yet fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Freeness versus maximal global Tjurina number for plane curves
status_evidence.snippet: Studies extremal values of the global Tjurina number for plane curves.
status_evidence.claim: Extremal Tjurina-number problems for plane curves and arrangements remain active.
